description: P6 field-mapping §2.2: discriminated symbol measurement representation. Q(v) carries a reference-design-px value bound to a precise measurement rule (U); the reference-design domain is signed (coordinates/displacements, e.g. a y-down offset Q(-135)), while size positivity is enforced by the consuming parameter schema. PT(v)/MM(v) carry physical magnitudes (positive) that must NOT participate in reference-design pixel scaling. The unit is discriminated by 'kind', never inferred from a field-name suffix. Closed: unknown kinds and extra fields are rejected.
